items.title: 67460_Sammy Price oral history interview
items.q: I just felt that I was above that. A show came to Dallas. I went to Tulsa; from Tulsa to Oklahoma City and from Oklahoma City to Kansas City. And I stayed in Kansas City from '29 to '32. ... you seen Ida Cox and Lovey Taylor and Trixie Smith and Mamie Smith

ctx.x: Right, they hadn't done very much of that. 'Cause, well, during those days you had Bessie Smith, Ida Cox...
